Independent publisher of regional history

Harrowgate Press is an independent publisher of regional history and landscape writing. We publish four titles a year from our office in Skipton.

See the catalogue

What we publish

Our list covers Pennine industrial history, upland farming, and the literature of walking. Print runs are 1,500 to 4,000 copies. Titles are priced from £14.99 to £28.00.

Submissions

We read submissions in January and July each year. Send a synopsis and two sample chapters to editorial@harrowgate-press.example.

Where we are

The office is at 8 Otley Street, Skipton, BD23 1EW. Call 01756 555 240.
